title: Continuity of an integral with a moving observable and law
target_statement: Let T be a topological parameter space and X a compact topological space with a measurable structure in which open sets are measurable. If F:T×X→ℝ is jointly continuous and t↦μ_t is a continuous curve of probability measures in the weak topology, then t↦∫F(t,x) μ_t(dx) is continuous.
